heritage.title: Keeping the tradition alive
heritage.p1: Carpet weaving here is folk art — a living thread of community, religion, and design passed through generations of Nepalese weavers.
heritage.p2: Each piece is hand-knotted with the double-knot technique and a dense pile: slow work that holds colour, pattern, and the feel of the loom.
heritage.p3: We keep that craft close — not as nostalgia, but as a practice still made by hand, for rooms that ask for something lasting.

about.title: Kantipur Carpet Craft Industries
about.imageAlt: Detail of wool and silk hand-knotted carpet
about.p1: Kantipur Carpet Craft Industries (K.C.C.I) is a house of hand-knotted Nepalese rugs — natural fibres, careful production, and designs meant to bring quiet beauty into a room.
about.p2: From first sketch to finished knot, we hold our own workshops so quality stays in the family. Our sister concern, Chang Carpet Manufacturers Industries (C.C.M.I), specialises in contemporary American-leaning design without letting go of traditional charm.
about.p3: Today more than two hundred looms and nearly twelve hundred adult Nepalese weavers work wool, silk, and other natural materials into both classic and modern pieces — inventory deep enough for intimate rooms and large commissions alike.

custom.title: Made to your measure
custom.imageAlt: Handwoven carpet texture in soft natural light
custom.p1: When a standard size or colour will not do, we weave to order — custom hues, motifs, and dimensions shaped with you.
custom.p2: Special commissions can reach sizes as large as twenty-five by forty feet, still hand-knotted and finished to the same standard as our collection pieces.
custom.p3: Share a sketch, a reference, or simply the room you have in mind. We will answer with options, timing, and next steps.
